create.name: Community Meditation Center (CMC)
create.bio:
The Community Meditation Center of New York is an insight meditation sangha that opened in 2007, after a small circle of seven people who sat with Allan Lokos and Susanna Weiss grew into something larger. Lokos, encouraged by his own teacher Sharon Salzberg, became its first guiding teacher and Weiss its executive director; the couple stepped back in 2021, and the Dutch-born teacher Bart van Melik has guided the community since. Its roots are in the Theravada-based insight tradition, with an emphasis on mindfulness, kindness, generosity and compassion.

The heart of CMC is a weekly Sunday morning gathering on Zoom, Sacred Sunday Pause, with meditation, a Dharma talk and reflection, led by van Melik or by one of a wide circle of visiting teachers from different lineages and backgrounds. Sessions are recorded and kept in an online archive. In person, the sangha meets for daylong retreats and special days in New York City, recently at New York Insight Meditation Center and Tibet House. The centre has never had a paid membership: its teachings are offered on a donation basis, and it makes a point of welcoming practitioners of every identity, in the city and around the world.

courses.title: A Day of Kindness: A Celebration and Annual Fundraiser for CMC
courses.description: A full day of practice at New York Insight Meditation Center and online: a quiet morning of walking and sitting meditation with Vera Ruangtragool and Bart van Melik, then afternoon hours led in turn by Devin Berry, Venerable Burin, Oneika Mays and Joseph Goldstein, and an evening panel. Join for one hour or the whole day.
